scope: Research preparation and optional parent-only guarded apply; no authoring/math review/acceptance, no native histories or main supervision edits.

iid_confirmation_required.reason: Parent supplies actual bounded readiness evidence; no independent acceptance is inferred.

failure_behavior: Any missing preimage, invalid binding, stale guard, changed inventory, dependency mismatch/cycle, unknown alias, unconfirmed IID receipts or active writer throws before production mutations; default preparation writes research files only.
before_hash_authority: Individual consumed snapshot input bindings are enforced wherever present; native extra context from justified_by/forward_refs is authenticated only by exact reconstruction of itemHash from the original raw snapshot-bound ready row, not latest metadata.
retry_behavior: Each late proposal attempt uses a unique research copy-on-write proposed-root, so failed preparation can be rerun safely; existing applied original ready rows require separately authenticated refresh history rather than automatic latest-row inference.

optional_later_lane_archives.required_if: A later owner-released writer changes baseline-bound inputs outside the default geometry/evidence/balance archives, such as GR65–79.
optional_later_lane_archives.format: Array or {files:[...]} of rows {file or path,before_file,raw_sha256 or before_raw_sha256}; every archive must match its own claimed bytes and the original consumed native binding to be used.

global_drain_scope: Parent confirmedByParent global drain must include every native/adopted writer present at evaluation/apply time, including any subsequently released GR65+ lane; the script must not interpret a partial live source as final.
